takes.h: Three special editions for the 40th anniversary of It
takes.p: Stephen King's site lists three anniversary editions of It: a US Scribner edition of 1,168 pages with no date announced, a UK Hodder edition of 1,088 pages listed for September 3, and a UK Hodder deluxe limited to 1,010 numbered copies, shipping November 26. The deluxe is not sold in the US or Canada.

takes.h: Lividian announces the Robert McCammon Library
takes.p: Lividian Publications will reissue Robert McCammon's backlist as hardcovers: Smyth-sewn, cloth-bound, with reversible jackets, art by François Vaillancourt and essays by Mathias Clasen. Baal and Bethany's Sin lead in 2026, at four titles a year. The Night Boat, They Thirst, Mystery Walk and Usher's Passing are in production for 2027.

Pan's Labyrinth is back in theaters in 3D for its twentieth anniversary: a limited run began October 8 and it went nationwide October 9, from Cineverse and Fathom. It is the film's first 3D release, with a new 4K/HDR master; Aaron Parry of SDFX Studios oversaw the conversion.

takes.h: NECA's ULTRAmate Ghost Face, with Dead by Daylight extras
takes.p: NECA's ULTRAmate Ghost Face includes several robes, among them a Dead by Daylight poncho, knives, a mock video-rental VHS tape, a red Dead by Daylight mask and a new Scary Movie mask. Pre-orders run through the NECA Store; no date has been announced.
